articles.title: Route 66 Hits 100: The 'Mother Road' That Refused to Fade Away
articles.summary: Route 66, the 2,400-mile highway from Chicago to Los Angeles, turns 100 on November 11, 2026. Eight states are celebrating with festivals, car shows, and a documentary tour ending in LA.

articles.title: AI and Consciousness: Readers Debate Whether Machines Could Ever 'Wake Up'
articles.summary: A Live Science poll asked if AI could become conscious. 43% of 290+ readers said yes without guardrails, while 29% said smarter architecture is needed. One joked, 'Maybe that is how Transformers started?'

articles.title: Def Leppard Documentary 'Long Live Def Leppard' to Rock Theaters in 2027
articles.summary: A new authorized documentary, 'Long Live Def Leppard,' hits theaters in early 2027. It follows the band's rise from Sheffield, England, to 110 million albums sold — and how they survived two devastating tragedies.
